question: From which kula does the northern transmission stream arise?
premises: The northern transmission stream is the topic
It is said to arise from the Kālī kula
inference: The northern transmission stream arises from the Kālī kula.
uncertainties: The subject described as arisen may be the goddess or the stream itself
plain_english: The northern transmission, indeed the northern one, arises from the Kālī kula.
